name: Seeker Of Shadows
detailed_description:
Dive into the heart of darkness with Seeker of Shadows. Your mission is to unravel the mysteries within different locations. Discover out-of-place objects, report your findings, and navigate through chilling mazes to survive encounters with eerie shadow figures. Prepare for a journey that transcends the boundaries of fear and curiosity.

Key Features:

  • Object Investigation: Explore the haunting family house, scrutinizing every corner for moved or unknown objects. Your keen observational skills will be your greatest asset.
  • Shadow Figures: Face the terror of shadowy entities drawn to the light. Traverse through the darkness, cautiously managing your surroundings to avoid their ominous presence.
  • Strategic Illumination: Wield a powerful flashlight to fend off the encroaching shadow figures. The light becomes both your ally and your only defense against the supernatural forces seeking to engulf you.
  • Maze-like Navigation: Journey through a complex network of hallways and mazes to reach the reporting room. Stay vigilant, for each step brings you closer to unraveling the mysteries within.
